runs.question: Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_081b1eac5ffeykP2n7dMQArOxd] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
The query returned **7180 blocks** for mainnet on 20 June 2026 from `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node`. Each row shows:

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `slot` | Beacon slot number |
| `slot_start_date_time` | Wall clock time of slot start |
| `first_seen_arrival_ms` | Earliest time (ms) after slot start that any node saw the block |
| `observer_count` | Number of unique nodes that reported seeing the block |

Blocks spanned slots ~14590401–14597998 (epochs ~202644–203305). Typical first-seen arrival times ranged from ~200–3600 ms, with most blocks seen within ~1200–1700 ms by ~156–158 observer nodes. The full dataset was truncated in display to 1000 rows but is available in `/tmp/panda-opencode-82icjzqy/share/opencode/tool-output/tool_f7e4e6070001voZ3xObpddsI9H`.

[Turn 2 | session=ses_081b1eac5ffeykP2n7dMQArOxd] Plot the distribution of those arrival times as a chart.
Chart generated and uploaded:

- **Host path**: `/home/runner/.panda/data/storage/d0993584ea6f/32f25471-82ac-4d66-b8db-a61b3651b835/arrival_distribution.png`

Distribution stats for the 7180 blocks: min **141 ms**, median **1,453 ms**, max **5,249 ms**.
